source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the contextually incomplete self-claim naturally while retaining the repetition of many and lead astray.
key_decisions.before: Many will come in my name saying, ‘I am he,’ and they will lead many astray.
key_decisions.after: Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and they will lead many astray.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am,’ and they will lead many astray.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the paired conflicts, repeated there will be, and the birth-pain image without calling them the end.
key_decisions.before: Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
key_decisions.after: For nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves first and must without turning the saying into a timetable.
key_decisions.before: And the good news must first be proclaimed to all nations.
key_decisions.after: And the good news must first be proclaimed to all nations.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the good news must first be proclaimed to all the nations.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the masculine participle’s standing, the deliberately indirect location, and Mark’s reader aside.
key_decisions.before: “When you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be—let the reader understand—then those in Judea must flee to the mountains.
key_decisions.after: “When you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not—let the reader understand—then those in Judea must flee to the mountains.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not—let the reader understand—then let those in Judea flee to the mountains.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps God as creator and the unparalleled past-and-future scope of the distress.
key_decisions.before: For those days will be a distress unlike anything from the beginning of the creation God created until now—and never again.
key_decisions.after: because those days will bring distress unlike any from the beginning of the creation God made until now—and never to be equaled again.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For those days will be distress, such as has not been from the beginning of creation that God created until now, and never shall be.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders all flesh idiomatically while preserving the emphatic chosen/choose repetition and divine shortening.
key_decisions.before: If the Lord had not shortened those days, no flesh would be saved. But for the sake of the elect whom he chose, he shortened the days.
key_decisions.after: If the Lord had not shortened those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the chosen, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if the Lord had not cut short the days, no flesh would be saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he cut short the days.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains both deictic claims and the command not to believe them.
key_decisions.before: If anyone then says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
key_decisions.after: Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Look, there!’ do not believe it.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both false roles, signs and wonders, deceptive purpose, and the conditional phrase.
key_decisions.before: False christs and false prophets will arise and produce signs and wonders in order to lead astray, if possible, the elect.
key_decisions.after: For false messiahs and false prophets will arise and perform signs and wonders to lead astray, if possible, the chosen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will give signs and wonders, in order to lead astray, if possible, the elect.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps falling stars and shaken heavenly powers without explaining the imagery.
key_decisions.before: the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.’
key_decisions.after: the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps angels rather than generic messengers and the full earth-to-heaven sweep of the gathering.
key_decisions.before: He will send the angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the farthest end of earth to the farthest end of heaven.
key_decisions.after: Then he will send out the angels and gather his chosen from the four winds, from the farthest end of the earth to the farthest end of heaven.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And then he will send the angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the end of earth to the end of heaven.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the compressed unspecified subject as it and the plural doors image without forcing a single referent.
key_decisions.before: In the same way, when you see these things happening, know that it is near, at the doors.
key_decisions.after: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near—right at the doors.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So also you, when you see these things happening, know that it is near, at the doors.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains this generation and the emphatic denial without eschatological harmonization.
key_decisions.before: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.
key_decisions.after: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Truly I say to you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains every excluded knower, including the Son, without theological qualification.
key_decisions.before: But concerning that day or hour, no one knows—not the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
key_decisions.after: “But no one knows about that day or hour—not the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But concerning that day or hour no one knows, neither the angels in heaven nor the Son, but only the Father.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves slave rather than weakening the social term, individual work, and the doorkeeper’s command.
key_decisions.before: It is like a man going away on a journey. He leaves his house, gives authority to his servants, assigns each one their work, and commands the doorkeeper to watch.
key_decisions.after: It is like a man away on a journey who left his house, gave authority to his slaves, assigned each one their work, and ordered the doorkeeper to stay awake.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is like a man away on a journey, having left his house and given authority to his servants, to each his work, and commanded the doorkeeper to watch.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the four Roman night watches in vivid ordinary language and the reason for vigilance.
key_decisions.before: Therefore watch, because you do not know when the master of the house is coming—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
key_decisions.after: Therefore stay awake, because you do not know when the master of the house is coming—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or at dawn.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore watch—for you do not know when the lord of the house is coming, whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning—

key_decisions.rationale: Expands the command’s audience exactly as the closing verse does and repeats the chapter’s governing imperative.
key_decisions.before: What I say to you, I say to everyone: Watch!”
key_decisions.after: What I say to you, I say to everyone: Stay awake!”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And what I say to you I say to all: Watch.”
